questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The Big Bang is a _____ theory about how the universe started expanding, and then made the stars and galaxies we see today.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter P and has 8 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Big Bang article.

questions.proof: The Big Bang is a physical theory about how the universe started expanding, and then made the stars and galaxies we see today.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Because most things become _____ as they expand, scientists assume that the universe was very small and very hot when it started.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter C and has 6 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Evidence” part of the Big Bang article.

questions.proof: Because most things become colder as they expand, scientists assume that the universe was very small and very hot when it started.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Big Bang: the most _____ scientific discovery of all time and why you need to know about it.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter I and has 9 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “More reading” part of the Big Bang article.

questions.proof: Big Bang: the most important scientific discovery of all time and why you need to know about it.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “_____ Fred Hoyle mockingly called the theory the "Big Bang" on his radio show.”
